dashboard.subtitle: Track office supplies and inventory across CI Cambodia.
dashboard.allStocked: Everything is above its minimum level.

settings.title: Settings
settings.appearanceHint: Choose how CI Inventory looks on this computer.

security.title: Password
security.hint: Changing your password needs your current password and a code from your authenticator app.

settings.subtitle: Preferences for this computer, your account security and administration.

brand.headline: Office supplies and inventory, under control.

rules.email: Does not contain your email name

setup.title: Set up CI Inventory
setup.subtitle: Create the administrator account. You will link your phone in the next step.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your CI Inventory account.
login.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask your administrator to reset it.

totp.title: Two-step verification
totp.subtitle: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for {{email}}.
totp.recoverySubtitle: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up your account.

enroll.title: Link your phone
enroll.subtitle: Every sign-in to {{email}} will need a code from your phone.
enroll.step1Hint: Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator, from the App Store or Google Play.
enroll.step2: Scan this QR code with the app
enroll.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
enroll.manual: Can't scan? Enter this key in the app instead:
enroll.step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows

recovery.title: Save your recovery codes
recovery.subtitle: Use one of these if you lose your phone. Each code works once.
recovery.warning: These codes will not be shown again. Print them or store them somewhere safe, away from this computer.
recovery.unavailable: The codes are no longer available on this screen.
recovery.confirm: I have saved my recovery codes

forceChange.title: Choose a new password
forceChange.subtitle: Your administrator gave you a temporary password. Set your own to continue.

lock.subtitle: CI Inventory is locked. Enter your password to continue.
lock.switchUser: Sign in as a different user

errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED_one: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{count}} minute.
errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED_other: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{count}} minutes.
errors.ACCOUNT_DISABLED: This account has been disabled. Contact your administrator.
errors.INVALID_CODE: That code is not valid. Check your authenticator app and try again.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your sign-in timed out. Please start again.
errors.SETUP_ALREADY_DONE: CI Inventory is already set up. Please sign in.
errors.WEAK_PASSWORD: The password doesn't meet the requirements.
errors.PASSWORD_REUSED: Choose a password different from your current one.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Please check the information you entered.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.DUPLICATE: That name or SKU is already in use.
errors.CATEGORY_IN_USE: This category is used by {{items}} item(s), so it cannot be deleted.
errors.LOCATION_HAS_STOCK: This location still holds stock for {{items}} item(s). Move it out before archiving.
errors.ITEM_ARCHIVED: Archived items cannot be moved. Restore it first.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_STOCK: Not enough stock at this location (available: {{available}}).
errors.NO_CHANGE: The counted quantity matches the current stock — nothing to adjust.
errors.LOCATION_REQUIRED: Choose a default location to receive the opening quantity.
errors.INVALID_IMAGE: That file is not a supported image (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP up to 15 MB).
errors.STEP_UP_REQUIRED: Please confirm with your authenticator code.
errors.CANNOT_CHANGE_SELF: You can’t do that to your own account. Ask another administrator.
errors.LAST_ADMIN: There must always be at least one active administrator.
errors.BACKUP_INVALID: That file is not a CI Inventory backup.
errors.BACKUP_PASSWORD: Wrong backup password, or the file has been altered.
errors.BACKUP_TOO_NEW: This backup was made by a newer version of CI Inventory. Update the app first.
errors.BACKUP_CORRUPT: The backup is damaged and cannot be restored.
errors.BACKUP_TAMPERED: The audit log inside this backup has been tampered with. It will not be restored.
errors.RESTORE_EXPIRED: The restore timed out. Choose the backup file again.

items.subtitle: Every item, its stock on hand and where it is kept.
items.emptyBody: Add the office supplies and equipment you keep in stock.
items.archiveBody: “{{name}}” will be hidden from lists and can no longer be moved in or out. Its history is kept, and you can restore it later.
items.duplicateSku: An item with this SKU already exists.
items.minStockHint: You are alerted when stock falls to this level. 0 = no alert.
items.openingHint: Received into the default location now.
items.trendSubtitle: End-of-day stock on hand ({{unit}}), last 90 days
items.openingNoLocations: Add a location first to record opening stock — you can stock in later.

stock.subtitle: Every receipt, issue, transfer and count — append-only and audited.
stock.emptyBody: Movements appear here as stock is received, issued, moved or counted.
stock.searchPlaceholder: Search item, SKU, person or note…
stock.needLocation: Add a location (for example, your storeroom) before recording stock.
stock.needTwoLocations: Transfers need at least two locations.
stock.noItemsYet: No items yet — create one on the Items page first.

categories.subtitle: Group items, e.g. stationery, cleaning, IT accessories.
categories.emptyBody: Create categories to group and filter items.
categories.duplicate: A category with this name already exists.
categories.deleteBody: “{{name}}” will be deleted. Categories that are still used by items cannot be deleted.

locations.subtitle: Storerooms, offices and shelves where stock is kept.
locations.name: Name
locations.emptyBody: Add at least one location before receiving stock.
locations.duplicate: A location with this name already exists.

labels.title: QR label
labels.subtitle: Scan to identify this item. Print and stick it on the shelf or box.

stepUp.title: Confirm it’s you
stepUp.body: Enter the current code from your authenticator app. Admin actions then stay unlocked for 5 minutes.

users.subtitle: Staff accounts, roles and access.
users.newHint: They receive a temporary password and link their phone at first sign-in.
users.duplicate: A user with this email already exists.
users.authenticatorReset: Phone link reset — they will link a new phone at next sign-in
users.tempDone: I have given it to them
users.tempWarning: This password is shown only once. Give it to the person directly; they must choose their own password and link their phone when they first sign in.

roleHints.admin: Full access, including users, settings, backups and the audit log.
roleHints.storekeeper: Manage items and record stock movements.

disable.title: Disable this user?
disable.body: {{name}} will no longer be able to sign in. Their history is kept.

enable.title: Enable this user?
enable.body: {{name}} will be able to sign in again.

resetPassword.title: Reset password?
resetPassword.body: {{name}}’s current password stops working. You will see a new temporary password once.

resetAuthenticator.title: Reset phone link?
resetAuthenticator.body: Use this if {{name}} lost their phone. Their authenticator and recovery codes stop working, and they link a new phone at next sign-in.

security.recoveryHint: Create a fresh set of 10 codes. Your old codes stop working immediately.
security.recoveryDone: New recovery codes created. Save them now — they will not be shown again.
security.activityHint: If you see something you don’t recognise, change your password and tell an administrator.

adminSettings.title: Organisation & security policy
adminSettings.hint: Applies to everyone using CI Inventory on this computer.
adminSettings.officeHint: Shown in the sidebar and on QR labels.
adminSettings.idleHint: 1–240. The app locks after this much inactivity on the computer.
adminSettings.reminderHint: Remind admins when the last backup is older than this.

backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.never: No backup has been made yet.
backup.createHint: Saves all data in one encrypted file. You need the backup password to restore it — it cannot be recovered if lost.
backup.restoreHint: Replaces ALL current data with the backup. A safety copy of the current data is kept automatically.
backup.wrongPassword: Wrong backup password, or the file has been altered.
backup.verified: Backup decrypted and verified: database intact, audit log untampered.
backup.confirmWarning: All current data on this computer will be replaced. Everyone will need to sign in again.
backup.restartingBody: The app is restarting with the restored data.
backup.reminderNever: No backup has been made yet. Protect your data with an encrypted backup.
backup.reminderOld_one: The last backup is {{count}} day old.
backup.reminderOld_other: The last backup is {{count}} days old.

audit.subtitle: Every sign-in and change, in a tamper-evident chain.
audit.verifyOk: Audit log verified: all {{count}} entries are intact and untampered.
audit.verifyBroken: Audit log integrity check FAILED at entry #{{id}} ({{reason}}). The log may have been tampered with — contact your administrator.

updates.title: Updates
updates.devBuild: Updates are off in development builds.

states.error: could not reach the update server

updates.manualOnly: New versions are installed manually — ask your administrator for the latest installer.

dash.byCategorySubtitle: Current value of stock on hand
dash.noIssues: No stock issued in this period.
dash.reorderSubtitle: Items at or below their minimum — suggested quantity restores twice the minimum
dash.reorderCopied: Reorder list copied — paste it into Excel or an email.
dash.reorderBudgetHint_one: to restock {{count}} item to twice its minimum
dash.reorderBudgetHint_other: to restock {{count}} items to twice their minimum
